TeleTune
Make Your Calls More Fun with TeleTune!
Are you tired of the same old boring ringtone? Want to give your callers a treat every time they call you? Then TeleTune is the perfect solution!
What is TeleTune?
TeleTune is a service that enables you to replace your standard ringtone with a song or melody of your choice. Instead of the usual tone, callers will hear a special tune that reflects your personality and mood.
Why Choose TeleTune?
•    Impress your callers: Make their calling experience more enjoyable with a fun and personalized song.
•    Make a Statement: Every call is an opportunity to express yourself. Choose TeleTune and transform your ringtone into a reflection of your unique style mood, or interests.
•    Curated for You:  TeleTune goes beyond simply providing choices. We understand the desire for music that resonates with your personality. Explore our extensive library and discover top hits and all-time classics that perfectly reflect your taste.

Activating TeleTune:
•    SMS: Text "START" to 25000 (Free SMS)
•    IVR: Dial 25000 and follow the prompts.
Deactivating TeleTune:
•    SMS: Text "STOP" to 25000
•    IVR: Dial 25000 and follow the instructions.
